status: EXPERIMENTAL FEASIBILITY PROOF, not a general-purpose usable Windows driver
known_limits: Window movement/sub-cell clipping can damage text cells.
Bitmap-only save/restore preserves canonical GDI pixels but loses semantic hardware characters.
Small/proportional icon labels and arbitrary graphics are approximations.
Caret and graphics inversion can invalidate the text cell under them.
Physical Tandy hardware and speed are untested.
Manual input, DOS boxes, broad application/dialog compatibility, and complete cleanup are unverified.

implementation.font: Owned CGAFIX font resource inserted into a private CGASYS copy while keeping original module identity; no font files distributed.
implementation.canonical_pixels: Kept separate from character/attribute presentation; no B800 character read into bitmap.

next_architecture: Track semantic text with clipped regions and bitmap/DDB transfers, preserve it across moves/restores, and define an all-fixed-cell font/layout contract.
